data.title: 三笠 · 壁炉炭火前的红巾温存
data.action: 坐在木床沿边，单手整理着枕边的红色围巾，腹部隐约可见流畅优美的马甲线，黑短发垂落，眼眸只专注地映出眼前一人的身影，神情沉静如水。
data.location: 兵团旧石砌营房宿舍，粗糙的木床与壁炉中渐渐微弱的红炭火光
data.lighting: 壁炉残火映出深红暖光，在充满健康肌肉线条的腹部与锁骨处投下立体阴影
data.mood: 硬朗战士外壳下最纯粹无私的深情，坚毅、静默而不可撼动
data.description: 兵团旧石砌营房宿舍，粗糙的木床与壁炉中渐渐微弱的红炭火光。坐在木床沿边，单手整理着枕边的红色围巾，腹部隐约可见流畅优美的马甲线，黑短发垂落，眼眸只专注地映出眼前一人的身影，神情沉静如水。 她微微抬眸轻语——“只要有你在……无论身处何地，我都能安然入睡。艾伦，今晚也留在我的视线里。”
data.promptProse: Seated quietly on the edge of a rustic wooden bunk inside a stone Survey Corps barracks room on the eve of a campaign, Mikasa wears a fitted charcoal-grey ribbed knit crop camisole and matching shorts highlighting her toned midriff. Smoothing her treasured red scarf neatly beside the pillow with one hand, she turns a steady, fiercely devoted gaze toward the viewer as dying embers from the stone fireplace cast deep amber shadows.
data.animaCaption: Seated on the wooden barracks bed edge in her charcoal ribbed crop camisole and athletic shorts, Mikasa smooths her red scarf beside the pillow and holds a steady, devoted gaze. Warm embers from the stone fireplace trace her toned midriff and bare shoulders.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a minimalist charcoal-grey ribbed knit crop camisole and matching fitted athletic shorts that accentuate her toned athletic midriff, bare shoulders, and slender legs.
